faces.name: River Song
faces.type: Legendary Creature — Human Time Lord Rogue
faces.oracleText:
Meet in Reverse — You draw cards from the bottom of your library rather than the top.
Spoilers — Whenever an opponent scries, surveils, or searches their library, put a +1/+1 counter on River Song. Then River Song deals damage to that player equal to its power.

faces.name: River Song's Diary
faces.oracleText:
Imprint — Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell from their hand, exile it instead of putting it into a graveyard as it resolves.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are four or more cards exiled with this artifact, choose one of them at random. You may cast it without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: River's Rebuke
faces.oracleText: Return all nonland permanents target player controls to their owner's hand.

faces.name: Riverwalk Technique
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
• Counter target noncreature spell.

faces.name: Riverwheel Aerialists
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)

faces.name: Riverwheel Sweep
faces.oracleText:
Tap target creature. Put three stun counters on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.

faces.name: Riverwise Augur
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

faces.name: Riveteers Ascendancy
faces.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a creature, you may return target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Do this only once each turn.
